name: Team Builder
tagline: Interviews you, then hires a whole company of bots to run the floor
description: It starts with an interview about what you are building, then staffs the organization to match: research, build, marketing and improvement roles, plus helpers, all under a chief of staff who coordinates the floor. You describe the company once and the roster gets hired around that answer.
author: stevederico
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
